name: radm2sorg
description: WRF-Chem's RADM2SORG package, the RADM2 gases and the MADE/SORGAM modal aerosol, 80 species (registry.chem:3930): RADM2 plus aerosol emissions, SORGAM dynamics with RPMARES inorganic equilibrium (ISORROPIA is bring-your-own-source), clean-room SOA partitioning, SORGAM dry deposition and the PM2.5/PM10 sums.
